result.summary: Found 2 minor issues: a spelling error in the search placeholder and some truncated/cropped restaurant text in the card carousel.

issues.description: The search placeholder says "Restarants, dishes, groceries" instead of "Restaurants, dishes, groceries".
issues.suggestion: Fix the placeholder copy to use the correct spelling of "Restaurants".

issues.description: Some restaurant card text is cut off at the right edge (e.g. "Trattoria Picco...") and a lower card is partially hidden behind the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Allow more padding or adjust card sizing/scroll spacing so important text and card content are fully visible above the fixed navigation.
